text.p: An international offering for Russia's RAO Gazprom, the world's largest natural gas company, was set at a preliminary price of $14.00 to $16.00 per American Depositary Share (ADS), the lead managers said in a statement.
Morgan Stanley and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said the offering will total 23.7 million ADS, with each ADS representing 10 registered ordinary shares.
"The final offer price for the ADSs will be determined by an open price bookbuilding process and will be confirmed during the week of October 21, 1996," Morgan Stanley and Dresdner said.

They said there was an over-allotment option of up to 15 percent of the size of the offering. If this option were exercised in full, it would increase the number of ADSs in the offering to 27,255,000, the leads said.
They said the ADSs were expected to be listed on the London Stock Exchange and were expected to be quoted on SEAQ International and to trade in the over-the-counter market.
CS First Boston and ING Barings are co-lead managers and NatWest Securities and Salomon Brothers are co-managers, the statement said. Dresdner Kleinwort Benson is financial advisor to Gazprom.
